subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should opted-in per-response usage footers display provider quota windows, and if so must they consume a prepared cached snapshot rather than perform a fresh provider lookup during reply finalization?
rationale: The user value is established, but automatic quota display changes the reply hot path and requires an explicit choice about freshness, latency, failure coupling, and snapshot ownership.

options.title: Cached snapshot footer
options.body: Show quota windows only from a lifecycle-owned provider usage snapshot, never blocking reply delivery on a fresh network call.

options.title: Live per-reply lookup
options.body: Allow a bounded provider lookup during each opted-in reply and explicitly accept the added latency and availability coupling.

options.title: Keep status-only
options.body: Leave provider quota windows on `/status` and CLI surfaces while keeping per-response footers limited to locally available turn and session data.

recommendation.title: Cached snapshot footer
recommendation.body: Show quota windows only from a lifecycle-owned provider usage snapshot, never blocking reply delivery on a fresh network call.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both the response usage footer and the provider-usage/status contracts requiring a unified ownership decision.
